1c278c1a-a341-44e0-9f2a-dc53993a5c29.title: about me
1c278c1a-a341-44e0-9f2a-dc53993a5c29.text:
Hi! I'm Aadivya.

I'm an 18 y/o founder, researcher and CS student @ UIUC.

To learn how to make videogames, I started learning how to code at ages 8–10, learning JS, Python and C++ (2015–2017). Later, from 10–13, I did a lot of game dev with Unity, Unreal Engine, C# and C++ (2017–2020).

From 14–15, my interests shifted towards software dev as I realized it was way more "useful", so I started working on software apps w/ JS, React, Next, Node, SQL/NoSQL, etc. (2021–2022). In 2022, after Ethereum started using proof-of-stake and blockchain became immensely more feasible for actually useful apps, I also worked on a few blockchain products.

In early 2023, after trying ChatGPT for the first time, I got really interested in generative AI's potential for making useful products, and since then I've been working on a lot of useful AI B2C/B2B products—that's my current area of interest.

Check out the projects and research threads to learn more about my work!

Later I worked on a research paper about the extent to which AI can automate exam correction (paper here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nGW64S67sgdOMj995O3g0Bfdl2k_EC_0vhrPwF9Ky58/edit?usp=sharing). Published this as my IB extended essay.

64d15c89-7f96-4223-9006-b4bfd4a35aee.title: principles
64d15c89-7f96-4223-9006-b4bfd4a35aee.text:
Some principles I've developed over the past 18 years of being alive:

- Value self-awareness and honesty above approval
- Respect and guard your attention
- Focus. Commit deeply to what's important.
- Practice humility in front of experience
- Act with optimism and take initiative
- Communicate with clarity and precision
- Accept reality and live in the present
- Embrace diversity, openness, and adaptability
- Let consistency and perseverance guide progress
- Avoid zero-sum thinking; seek positive-sum outcomes wherever possible
- Don't make assumptions without evidence (literally the perfect anxiety cure)
- Use embarrassment and discomfort as opportunities to grow
- Value solitude
- No concept/idea/procedure is ever "complex". Finding things "complex" just means that you don't sufficiently understand the fundamentals intuitively enough.
